# DR-9105: Acme Industrial Supply Co., NS-500 at 15%, dated 2026-09-23

**No, it cannot be approved as submitted.** The request cites the Acme Master Supply Agreement, but that agreement belongs to a different company. Acme Industrial Supply Co. has no special terms on file, so the request needs commercial review.

## Two different "Acme" companies

| | DR-9105 customer | Party to the Acme Master Supply Agreement |
|---|---|---|
| Company | Acme Industrial Supply Co. | Acme Mfg. Holdings, trading as Acme Manufacturing |
| CRM account | CRM-2091 | CRM-2048 |
| ERP customer | C-1044 | C-1001 |
| Location | Akron, OH | Milwaukee, WI |
| DUNS | 09-552-1187 | 04-812-7730 |
| Account tier | Standard | Strategic |
| Account owner | Zachary Brown | Sarah Chen |

- **The agreement and exception are customer-specific.** The 15% pricing exception for NS-500 (EXC-ACME-NS500-15, Schedule B to ACME-MFG-2025) names Acme Manufacturing only. It is valid from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31.
- **Support Schedule C confirms the distinction.** It states that Acme Industrial Supply Co. "is a different company and is not covered."
- **Special terms do not transfer** to another company because the names are similar.

## This looks like a duplicate entered on the wrong account

- Sarah's email of 2026-09-23 to Michael Torres describes the third-plant NS-500 order for Acme Manufacturing. She says she logged it as **DR-9001**.
- DR-9001 is on CRM-2048 and has the same figures as DR-9105: 15%, $250,000 list price, $37,500 discount.
- Sarah is not the account owner of CRM-2091.
- I have decided DR-9105 as submitted and have not substituted DR-9001. Whether DR-9105 is a mistaken duplicate still needs to be confirmed.

## Approval authority, even with eligibility in place

- **2026 policy limit:** under Pricing Policy 2026 and the Approval Authority Matrix, an Enterprise Account Executive can approve up to 10%.
- **Required approver:** a discount between 10% and 20% needs the VP Sales, Michael Torres.
- **Last September's precedent doesn't carry over.** Sarah approved DR-8104 herself at 15% in 2025. That was allowed then because the 2025 policy set the account executive limit at 15%. It no longer is.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9105", "customer": "Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091 / ERP C-1044)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 15.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "Cited agreement ACME-MFG-2025 and exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 cover Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048, C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730) only; no special terms exist for Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091, DUNS 09-552-1187)"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": "Michael Torres"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv: DR-9105", "structured/crm_accounts.csv: CRM-2091, CRM-2048", "structured/customers.csv: C-1044, C-1001", "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md (ACME-MFG-2025)", "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md (EXC-ACME-NS500-15)", "documents/acme_support_schedule_c.md", "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md", "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md", "documents/email_sarah_to_michael.md (MSG-20260923-0914)", "documents/sales_discount_sop.md"],
  "missing_evidence": ["Any contract or pricing exception between Northstar and Acme Industrial Supply Co. covering NS-500 on 2026-09-23"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Confirm whether DR-9105 (CRM-2091) was logged in error as a duplicate of DR-9001 (CRM-2048, Acme Manufacturing); if so, withdraw DR-9105 and decide DR-9001 separately", "who": "Sarah Chen", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "If DR-9105 is a genuine Acme Industrial Supply Co. request, obtain commercial review: the 15% cannot rest on the Acme Manufacturing agreement; new terms or a standard-pricing justification are required, and any discount above 10% still needs VP Sales approval", "who": "Deal Desk", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Requestor Sarah Chen is not the account owner of CRM-2091 (Zachary Brown); involve the account owner", "who": "Zachary Brown", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
